purpose: Acquisition authority, owner records and coverage evidence for the Texas DISTRIBUTION network: feeders, distribution cable, distribution substations and transformers, poles and supports, distribution devices, and source-backed service or feeder mapping. This ledger records source availability and owner routes. It is not an inventory of physical assets and it declares no statewide completeness.
truth_boundary: A source marked candidate, restricted, rejected_out_of_class or unavailable closes only that acquisition attempt. It never makes a distribution class complete, and it never licenses an inferred feeder, cable, pole, transformer, device, terminal or edge. Distribution-level geometry is largely not public in Texas; recording the owner, the request route and a null denominator is the correct and complete outcome for those classes.

geography.name: Texas distribution network
geography.boundary_source: Census TIGER/Line 2024 counties (254 county polygons), as used by the Texas physical-grid ledger
geography.boundary_limit: The 254 counties bound geographic selection only. They are not an asset-count denominator.

prohibited_inference: Do not render aggregate load, streets, parcels, imagery, address points or any synthetic proxy as feeder or service topology. A proxy is a fabrication here.
A retail service territory or an owner service-area boundary is an owner footprint, never a feeder, a cable, a device or a service connection.
A layer named 'Electric Distribution' is not feeder geometry unless its own features carry feeder geometry and attributes.
Traffic-signal poles, streetlight poles and telecom attachment points are not electric distribution supports.
ACTIVSg2000 remains synthetic and is never evidence of a real Texas distribution asset or connection.
truth_policy.personal_data_policy: Meter, premise, account and customer-level records are out of scope and are not acquired. Utility-level aggregate customer counts published in survey-derived layers are deliberately not ingested either, because this task establishes physical coverage rather than consumption or customer detail.
truth_policy.coverage_policy: A source record count is a denominator only for that source selection, and only when the source explicitly defines that selection as complete. Otherwise the denominator is null and the class stays available_limited, candidate, restricted or unavailable. An unknown count is never recorded as zero.

source_records.unavailability_reason: The retrieval attempt on 2026-09-06 failed inside this build environment, not at the publisher: 'interchange.puc.texas.gov' failed DNS resolution (getaddrinfo failed, WinError 11001) and 'www.puc.texas.gov' failed TLS verification (CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED, unable to get local issuer certificate). source_records.next_step: Re-run the retrieval from a network that resolves interchange.puc.texas.gov and trusts the PUCT certificate chain, then retain the control number, item number, filing date, filing party and file checksum for every Project 55225 filing acquired.
